permission_evidence.statement: The official OmniPicker URDF archive declares Apache-2.0 in robot_description/package.xml. The archive, source mesh and URDF SHA256 values match the recorded source. The package.xml evidence is archived without modification.

redistribution.note: License identification is based on the official package metadata, not on user confirmation, download availability, the SDK license or the repository license. The official archive contains no standalone LICENSE or NOTICE file; its package.xml declaration is the archived evidence. The repository root LICENSE supplies the Apache-2.0 text.
